resources.string: A lightweight, private web browser for Android TV and Google TV.\n\nSofa has no accounts, no analytics, no ads and no servers of its own. Your history, bookmarks and settings stay on this device. The only connections it makes are to the sites you visit and, if you ask it to, your search engine\'s suggestions and the blocklist address you choose.

resources.string: Needed to stay signed in to sites
Without cookies you\'ll be signed out of sites and won\'t be able to sign in. Turn cookies off?
Stops embedded content from tracking you across sites
Asks sites not to sell or share your data. Off by default: few browsers send it, so it can make you easier to recognise. Do Not Track is never sent.
Checks pages against Google\'s list of dangerous sites; shares partial page-address hashes with Google
Pages you visit stay in History, on this device, for this long. Older ones are removed. Never: nothing is saved.
Cookies, site storage, cache, history and where you stopped videos
Delete cookies, site storage, cache, history, saved site icons, where you stopped videos and your protected-content answers? Bookmarks and Quick access are kept.
Video is decoded by the web engine, with the TV\'s hardware where the format allows. On 4K TVs the engine shows it through Sofa\'s HD window, and the TV upscales it.
Your TV\'s web engine is out of date

Sofa shows pages with the web engine that comes with your TV (Android System WebView). This one is quite old. Sofa can\'t update it, but your TV can: check its app store, or the TV maker\'s updates. Older versions may be missing security fixes, and some sites may not work properly. You can keep browsing in the meantime.

Open the app store on your TV and look for \"Android System WebView\", then choose Update. If your TV has no app store, updates come with the TV\'s system updates, so check its settings or the maker\'s website.
